reasons.claim: 3.58 ha regeneration felling notification in Osby, status notified. Completed felling overlaps only 0.009 ha (0.2%).

One eligible species within 250 m: Goodyera repens (VU vascular plant, site-bound, forest-associated; threats include lack of dead wood and increased openness). One record at 0 m, so inside the polygon, from 2024 with 10 m uncertainty.

Effort within 1000 m is low (29 records, 10th percentile, county median 136), so the record comes from a sparsely recorded area. All 3 near-site records are from a single observation day, and other records there may be missing.

uncertainties: The record is a single observation; it shows the species was recorded, not that it currently occupies the exact felling area.
Low effort means a single visit may account for most nearby records; other species may be missing.
The 10 m uncertainty is small relative to the site's 107 m equivalent radius, so the position inside the polygon is fairly well placed.
not_established: Population size or extent of Goodyera repens on the site.
Forest age or structure of the stand.
Legality of the felling or any measure of biodiversity.
next_action: Reviewer should prioritise a field check for Goodyera repens at the 2024 record location inside the polygon, before felling can start, and look at dead wood and stand continuity.
